description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, Octane render, vibrant saturated colors, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Hungry looking Archelon (giant prehistoric sea turtle) head with an open beak
layer_3_action.action: The Archelon head is surrounded by a translucent pink prehistoric jellyfish, a golden-scaled fish, a coiled striped ammonite shell, a cluster of bright green sea lettuce fronds, and a slippery purple squid, each at geometric positions that form an invisible five-pointed star around the turtle head with a caption in bright red mixed case letters that reads Marine Diets!
